releases.body:
opencode v2 plugin API port. Requires opencode >= 2.0.20.

- Server: `Plugin.define({ id, setup(ctx) })` entrypoint, tools via
  `ctx.tool.transform`, session settle via `ctx.event.subscribe`,
  `idea_start` uses `ctx.session.create` + `ctx.session.prompt`
- Native `/idea` and `/ideas` slash commands registered via
  `ctx.command.transform` — no manual copying of command files
- CLI/TUI: reactive `ctx.keymap.layer` (palette takeover hack and
  delete-mode removed), dialogs/toasts via `ctx.ui`, sidebar via
  `ctx.ui.slot({ append: "sidebar.content" })`, theme tokens from
  `ctx.theme`
- Local-path installs: root `server.ts` / `index.ts` / `tui.ts`
  re-exports (v2.0.20 ignores package.json exports for local dirs)
- Install with the v2 `plugins` key (single entry loads both server
  and TUI parts); see README for details
- Test suite fully ported to the v2 API (`bun test`, 77 tests)
- Store format unchanged — existing ideas.db data keeps working


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/apilot/opencode-idea-inbox/compare/v0.6.3...v0.6.4
